Communications Systems Policy
Telephones, mail systems, computers, internet access, email, and etc. provided by The Company
are company property and may be accessed by The Company in the ordinary course of business.

Employees should have no expectation of privacy in the information contained in voicemail or
computers. Employees have no proprietary interest in any voicemail or email and The Company
reserves the right to monitor, listen to, view, copy, disclose or delete any telephone
conversations, voicemails or emails, including blogging, at any time. Installation of either unauthorized software or hardware on any of our computer systems is
strictly prohibited. It is expected that there will be times when it is necessary to either make or
receive personal telephone calls. Personal use of The Company-provided telephone for long-
distance and toll calls is not permitted. You may be required to reimburse The Company for any
charges resulting from personal use of the telephone or if you incur additional fee services
charges. Information Technology Support

Safety in the Workplace
Security Policy
The Company is committed to the safety and security of our customers, Employees, and other
company assets. To that end, all staff must remain vigilant for any type of situation(s),
person(s), or device(s) that could pose a threat of any type in any way and should report any
concerns immediately as appropriate. All Employees must also complete all required actions
regarding safety and safety checks as stipulated in your brand’s training and operations
manuals.

A two (2) week notice is required for all full time and part-time Employees, and a thirty (30) day
notice is required for all Management positions.

If employees do not fulfill the required notice,
hourly Employees will be reduced to minimum wage and lose all bonus potential, within the
rules and regulations of the Fair Labor Standard Act. You must fulfill your notice to receive any bonuses that have not yet been paid out. No bonuses
will be paid upon involuntary termination of employment. All Employee discounts for items and
services will cease immediately upon separation of employment. Employee Records
The Company will maintain a file on each Employee. Personnel files are the property of The
Company and will be treated as any other confidential information. All personnel files are kept
in the Personnel Platform Systems via the systems below or at the Corporate Office:
o Sun Tan City – MyGlow
o Buff City Soap – MyGlow
o Crunch Fitness – Woven
It is the responsibility of each employee to promptly notify The Company of any changes in
personnel data.

Protecting the Client from Overexposing
It is important to understand how the tanning equipment works and it is the employee’s
responsibility to prevent clients from overexposure. Clients may tan only one time per day in the UV bed, and one time per day in the VersaSpa ®. Never let a client coerce the employee into allowing two visits

49 | P a g e
in one day. Likewise, if a client tells you that he/she has tanned elsewhere the same day or been
in the sun all day; you may not tan them. Consent Forms (New Client Release Forms)
Every client must complete and sign a Sun Tan City consent form (New Client Release Form)
found in our system. Eye Protection
All clients using a tanning bed must use some form of FDA approved eye protection. VersaSpa® Recommendations
The FDA recommends the use of protective eyewear, lip balm, and nose filters during sunless
visits.

Tanning While Pregnant
It is recommended that pregnant women consult their doctor before using the VersaSpa® an/or
tanning in the UV equipment. Tanning with Skin Cancer
It is The Company’s policy not to tan someone who we know has (or has had) skin cancer
without a written statement from the client’s doctor giving approval. Minors
Those clients who are under the age of 18 must have the signed permission of a parent to be able to
tan at Sun Tan City. Children Left Unattended
No children under the age of 12 will be allowed to be left unattended on the premises of The
Company at any time.
